name: @telperion/elements
description: Framework-agnostic web components built with Lit: Material Symbols / Simple Icons / theSVG icons, declarative client-side router, drag-and-drop primitives, details accordion with FIFO open caps, a CSS-anchored popover, a form-associated selectbox with single/multi-select, a form-associated button, portals that render content into named outlets elsewhere in the document, a localized and optionally live date/time with moment-style formatting, and Shiki-powered syntax-highlighted code (inline or block) with lazily loaded languages.
